name: trialpilot
description: Test a few versions of a video as Instagram trial reels from Claude.
long_description: Trialpilot turns one video into a few lightly edited versions (a new hook line, a different opening, speed, zoom, look or sound) and posts each one as an Instagram trial reel. Trial reels are shown to people who don't follow you yet, so you can see which version works before your followers see any of them. Nothing goes out without your yes, and each account signs in once in its own browser window. Everything runs on your computer through instagram.com rather than an official Instagram API.
